acceptance.prompt_count: Each measured request records exactly one prompt-token count parsed from the production server log after the request-specific log offset; usage.prompt_tokens must equal it.
acceptance.privilege: The complete campaign runs as bmarti44 through the existing user-systemd cgroup and contains no sudo invocation.
acceptance.execution_binding: Before runtime, every profile artifact digest is verified. Every arm binds the live command, allowlisted environment, binary identity, and stable model device/inode/size; the collector recomputes and validates those bindings.
acceptance.idle_boundary: Initial and terminal checks reject ds4-server, llama-server, fio, the selected listener, or a surviving campaign unit.
acceptance.context_semantics: The profile separately records the model-supported 1,048,576 cap and the measured 32,768 server cap.
acceptance.formula: Prefill time is GLM wall time divided by matched DSV4 wall time; its one-sided upper 95% confidence bound must be <=1.25.
